hook_line: DRISHYAM 3 OUT-EARNS FIRST TWO FILMS COMBINED

hook_stat.sub: Worldwide total for the three-film Drishyam franchise

diaspora_bullets: A Hindi thriller holding international screens for four weeks
Drishyam 3 alone earned more than the first two films combined
news_summary: Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3 has reached Rs 578.64 crore worldwide after 24 days, out-earning the first two films combined and taking the franchise past Rs 1,000 crore, according to Koimoi.
payoff: At Rs 578.64 crore, Drishyam 3 sits Rs 21.36 crore short of Rs 600 crore worldwide.
